name: Arcane Propulsion Arm
sourceBook: Eberron: Rising from the Last War
description: This prosthetic appendage was developed by artificers of House Cannith. To attune to this item, you must attach it to your arm at the wrist, elbow, or shoulder, at which point the prosthetic magically forms a copy of the appendage it's replacing. While attached, the prosthetic provides these benefits:

data.attunementRequirement: by a creature missing a hand or an arm
